title: Measurement of XylE Enzyme Activity by Microplate Reader
author: Ji Gao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7suhnew
materials: Turn on the microplate reader and computer. Run the software to set the protocol and plate layout.
Export the data from the software. Properly dispose of the contaminated cell culture and microplates!

steps.title: Plate Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of cell culture per well, using replicates and controls to avoid mistakes or deviation.

steps.title: Measure Initial Cell Density
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the cell culture at 600 nm to estimate cell amounts.

steps.title: Establish Baseline Absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the cell culture at 377 nm to establish the baseline (A377) before the reaction.

steps.title: Add Catechol Substrate
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL of 10 mM catechol to every well (resulting in a working concentration of 0.25 mM) and plate immediately.

steps.title: Mix Plate
steps.instruction: Shake the plate for 5 seconds at 600 rpm.

steps.title: Measure Enzyme Activity
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the cell culture at 377 nm, either continuously (e.g., every 10 seconds) or after a specific period of time (e.g., 1 minute 30 seconds).

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Normalize the A377 value by the optical density at 600 nm to create a Time-A377 plot, or subtract the baseline absorbance from the value measured after a specific period of time.
